strategies.name: opening_range_breakout_close_entry
strategies.entry_summary: Define the 15-minute opening range from the 9:30 New York candle high and low. Enter long at the open of the next candle after a candle breaks above the range and closes outside it, with a cutoff of not taking new entries after the 12:00 candle.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss at the bottom of the opening range and target 1.5R.

variants.timeframe_note: 15-minute chart; opening range is the 9:30 candle
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for a candle to break out and close above the range, then enter at next candle open
variants.target_note: 1.5R target; no entries after the 12:00 candle
variants.transcript_quote: I prefer to wait for the candle to actually break through and then close above. So, in this case, my signal is this candle here because it's the first

strategies.entry_summary: On a 5-minute chart, define the opening range from the first three candles of the day. After an initial breakout above the range, wait for a pullback candle that breaks back through the range but closes back above it, then enter long only when the next price action breaks the most recent high as a b
strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss goes at the bottom of the opening range; the speaker also mentions the stop could alternatively go at the bottom of the pullback candle. Initial tested target is 1.5R, with larger target variants also tested.

variants.variant_label: Break of recent high confirmation, 1.5R target
variants.timeframe_note: 5-minute chart; opening range still based on first 15 minutes via first three 5-minute candles
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: after breakout, wait for pullback candle to dip through the range and close back above it, then enter on break of thes

strategies.name: opening_range_retest_stop_order_at_range_high
strategies.entry_summary: After an opening-range breakout, use a stop order placed at the top of the opening range so that if price pulls back to the range and bounces, the long entry triggers immediately without waiting for a break of the prior high.
strategies.exit_summary: Keep the stop loss at the bottom of the opening range and use a 1.5R take-profit target.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: no continuation confirmation; enter immediately via stop order at the top of the ORB on retest
variants.transcript_quote: This time, the stop loss is still at the bottom of the range. I have a 1.5 take profit, but now I'm using a stop order at the top of the orb.

strategies.name: opening_range_midpoint_retracement_stop_order
strategies.entry_summary: After measuring the breakout from the top of the opening range, wait for price to retrace deeper to the midpoint of the opening range and buy immediately there with a stop order, without waiting for a previous high to be broken.
strategies.exit_summary: Use a stop loss smaller than before because the entry is at the midpoint; the speaker explicitly frames targets as at least 1.5R and possibly more from that tighter stop.
